snippet.title: Creating the demo for my indie game! | Metro Gravity Devlog 2
snippet.description:
Wishlist Metro Gravity!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2986450/Metro_Gravity/ 

Join the discord!
https://discord.gg/RM5hktBqrv 

Other socials: https://linktr.ee/mrkogamedev

Welcome back! In this devlog, I take you through the components that make up Metro Gravity, and what I've added to my solo gamedev project I've been working on for the past year. 
I am almost ready to launch a Steam Demo, which is one of the main milestones!

0:23 - 1. Why a demo?

2:57 - COMBAT
3:57 - GRAVITY
5:40 - MAP

7:04 - Coping
